scope: Actual compiled Svelte UI in Chromium; Tauri/native-provider test doubles only.

tests.name: One top tab strip; distinct provider registry; inspector closed after legacy migration
Providers, Tools and Connect are utilities; websites retain one set of tabs
App menu has keyboard navigation, restores focus and hides untrusted native surface
Ctrl-W closes a utility page without closing the selected website
Every existing management screen remains reachable from the app menu
Arrow, Home, End, Ctrl-Tab and reverse tab navigation use the single tab strip
Top-tab context menu supports reorder, keyboard access and confirmed profile clearing
Drag-and-drop tab ordering remains available without the sidebar
Closing a top tab preserves its detected provider and reopening does not duplicate it
Inspector is opt-in, bounds follow it and the closed preference persists
Internal addresses identify management pages and never create remote provider tabs
Sixteen tabs fit via strip scrolling; controls and menus remain usable at 1000 × 680
Spinning/idle rings remain on the top tabs and respect reduced motion
Chrome navigation does not authorize tools or delete profiles; no runtime errors
